description.fun: A huge, moose-like beast made of layered rock, carrying a cracked ritual cauldron on its head. The cauldron is the real Pokémon, brought to life by the fear of people in ancient times. Its head is so heavy that just lowering it slowly to the ground splits the earth with fissures over 50 metres deep. The ding cauldron it's based on was a symbol of imperial power in ancient China.
description.guide: A Dark and Ground-type Legendary Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, one of the four treasures of ruin. Its true form is the ritual vessel on its head, and its body is made of rock and earth. It is known as the Vessel of Ruin.
description.tagline: A rock moose wearing a cracked ancient cauldron as antlers
